summary: This document defines a generic structure for the Switching Capability Specific Information carried in GMPLS Interface Switching Capability Descriptors. It can be used by routing protocols with any particular technology, so each new technology does not need its own layout.

eli5.summary: Rather than inventing a new form for every kind of network, this makes one flexible form that all of them can reuse.

questions: what is generalized scsi in gmpls
